 DK Metcalf hauls in 11 passes Sunday 
 by Ari Koslow | Steelers Correspondent | Mon, Oct 19th 2026, 2:03am EDT 
 DK Metcalf caught 11-of-15 targets for 93 yards in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Metcalf took over late as he totaled 12 targets in the fourth quarter and overtime period alone. He'll remain in the WR2/WR3 range with both Michael Pittman Jr. and Roman Wilson on IR.
